articleTitle: Low Power Remote Upgrade Design for IoT Devices Based on MQTT Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: With the development of IoT devices, especially for the use of battery IoT devices penetrate into certain areas of production and life, such devices have more stringent requirements for the service life of the battery. In order to meet the upgrade demand for improvement at the same time, in order to improve the upgrade efficiency in order to achieve the upgrade to minimize the problem of power consumption, this paper proposes a MCU remote upgrade program, including the program custom function area upgrade and the basic code area upgrade, to achieve the program upgrade diversification, according to the upgrade needs to choose the upgrade method. The customized function area upgrade can only upgrade the function area set in advance, and the preset functions can be realized by upgrading this function area, which can save the upgrade time and bandwidth to achieve the demand of low power consumption. Basic code area upgrade can upgrade the overall configuration, which can be used when adding new functions to the device. For products with poor network conditions, the MQTT protocol provides a lightweight, low-bandwidth requirements, adaptable to unstable network environments, and at the same time, you can choose the quality of service to deliver the message data just once, which ensures the reliable transmission of upgrade packets and takes into account the problem of low power consumption.

articleTitle: SimRCOD: Simple Reconstructed and Contrastive learning for Graph Outlier Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: Outlier detection on attributed networks has extensive applications in fields like financial trading and social networks. Methods based on graph deep learning for outlier detection have attracted researchers’ attention due to their excellent performance in solving high-dimensional attributes and sparse structures. However, existing methods are based on graph reconstructed learning or graph contrastive learning, which fail to fully utilize the rich information in networks. Furthermore, since reconstruction-based methods input the entire dataset, it is difficult for these methods to expand to larger networks. To combine the advantages of reconstructed and contrastive learning without increasing the model complexity, we propose a simple self-supervised outlier detection framework based on attributed reconstruction and neighbour contrast, named SimRCOD. Our framework simultaneously identifies outliers from two perspectives, i.e., reconstruction difficulty and neighbour matching, then uses a statistical scorer to calculate the abnormality degree of all nodes based on multiple rounds of evaluation. Additionally, as both graph reconstruction and contrast require graph encoders, we reduce model complexity by sharing one encoder. Experimental results on the benchmark datasets show that our framework has better performance than the classical methods.

articleTitle: Experimental design method for air defense and anti-missile weapons based on uniform design
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: Due to the rapid development of modern military technology, aircraft have become one of the main threats to opponents in modern warfare during military operations. Air missile defense has also become a focus. This article demonstrates an effective performance optimization method. The study of this experimental design method is of great significance to the development of air defense and antimissile weapons and equipment systems. At present, experimental research on air defense and anti-missile weapons and equipment systems at home and abroad rarely adopts uniform design methods. This paper uses the uniform design method to optimize the testing of air defense and antimissile weapons and equipment systems. In the parameter space including 6 factors and 30 levels, the uniform design method was used to determine the effective combination of factor levels and the factors that have the greatest impact on system performance. Experiments have proven that this method can improve the interception accuracy of incoming aircraft. The proposed method is proven to be an effective interception accuracy optimization method and is applicable to other combat systems

articleTitle: Intelligent Monitoring Systems for Marine Organisms in Nuclear Power Plant Intakes: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: Nuclear power plants, due to their operational processes and safety requirements, are primarily located along coastal areas where they leverage seawater for cooling purposes. Ensuring a consistent supply of cooling water is of paramount importance. However, recent shifts in marine ecology have presented challenges to traditional protective measures adopted by nuclear power plants, thrusting the safety of their cooling sources into the spotlight. Although the implementation of interception nets and the enhancement of grid backflush capabilities have alleviated some concerns, these are fundamentally based on passive defense mechanisms. As a result, Intelligent technologies for monitoring marine organisms at the intake systems of nuclear power plants have garnered widespread attention. This survey seeks to elucidate the current state and prospects of Intelligent Monitoring Algorithms at nuclear power plant intake systems, dissect the underlying key technologies, and provide a reference for future research and applications.

articleTitle: Research on Transient Electromagnetic Interference of Switch Operation in Substations
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: With the progress of the related techniques in the power system, the voltage grade constantly increases, which makes the electromagnetic interference in substation becomes a hot topic and research direction worth researching. To this end, this paper focuses on the what phenomenon will occur when the switch operation is conducted in the substation. In particular, electromagnetic inference caused by switch operation affects the current transformer and potential transformer in the secondary system in the substation, and this has been researched with the basis of the multivariable gray model. Compared with the original multivariable gray model, the proposed approach is optimized by selecting boundary conditions. This modification enables the multivariable gray model to be more general and also leads to model improvement. The results of the example analysis show that the proposed approach requires less data and has high prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: SLAM Loop Closure Detection Algorithm Based on 3D Bag-of-Words Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: In outdoor environments, the loop closure detection in laser-based SLAM faces challenges such as complex lighting variations, low-texture regions, occlusions, and dynamic objects, which limit the accuracy and efficiency of loop closure detection. To address this issue, a novel laser-based SLAM loop closure detection algorithm is proposed, specifically designed for outdoor environments, based on three-dimensional global descriptor features. The algorithm utilizes a BoWЗD model constructed from the three-dimensional laser features for precise point-to-point matching and loop closure detection. The proposed algorithm is integrated into the LeGO-LOAM system and evaluated on the publicly available KITTI dataset. Experimental results demonstrate a 64% improvement in absolute trajectory accuracy and reduced computational time compared to the baseline algorithm.

articleTitle: Deformable Convolution combined with dual Attention mechanism for skin lesion segmentation algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: In response to skin lesions with low contrast and irregular, blurry boundaries compared to the surrounding skin, this paper presents a skin lesion segmentation algorithm that combines deformable convolution with an attention mechanism based on M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>SNet.In the encoder, the first layer ENCA s two CBRs to reduce parameter and computational load. Each CBR layer replaces regular convolution with deformable convolution to adapt to irregular shapes, and the activation function Mish is used instead of RELU to capture fine details. Context transformers are introduced in layers 2-5 of ENCB to extract crucial features. In the multiscale subtractor, learning weights are introduced when fusing feature maps by subtraction, further extracting critical features while reducing redundant information. In the decoder, SimAM is introduced at each layer to fuse crucial features. Lanczos interpolation is used instead of bilinear interpolation for upsampling, reducing artifacts and maintaining smooth edges to enhance feature fusion capabilities. Experiments conducted on the public dataset ISIC2018 show that JA, DC, SE, AC, and SP improved by 3.57%, 4.49%, 4.07%, 1.24%, and 4.19% compared to the suboptimal algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Follow-up Question Answering APP based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: At present, most of the health follow-up systems in China are relatively simple in function and can provide limited services. Patients cannot get a good answer in such a question and answer system. However, most doctors have a huge daily workload and cannot respond to patients ' problems in a timely manner. This paper introduces the Follow-up Question Answering APP based on knowledge graph, which has the functions of follow-up message, online diagnosis, intelligent question and answer. The APP uses professional medical websites and in-service doctors ' medical records as initial data to construct knowledge graph storage and Neo4j database, and based on this, realizes automatic question answering function, and provides reference function in the doctor diagnosis module. The APP is convenient to use and reliable information can meet the actual needs of users.

articleTitle: A hybrid equilibrium optimizer with differential evolution algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: For the population diversity decreasing rapidly in differential evolution (DE), a novel hybrid algorithm based on Equilibrium Optimizer (EO) and DE (HEODE) is presented. Firstly, a sharing learning mutation strategy is introduced in DE based on the sharing individual. By learning from the sharing individual, information exchange among the whole population can be achieved. Secondly, an effective hybridization mechanism is proposed to combine the advantages of two algorithms. A serial of experiments are used for effectiveness verification among 12 DEs and 5 none-DE based algorithms. The test results validate that HEODE outperforms all competitors.

articleTitle: Design of Smart Bracelet System Based on STM32 for People Prone to Thermoplegia
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: As the global greenhouse effect intensifies, summer temperatures continue to rise in some areas, leading to a surge in the risk of thermoplegia among outdoor workers. In view of this, this paper designs a smart bracelet system based on STM32, which includes an external sensor module, a communication module, a display module, and an alarm module, when the user works outdoors, the bracelet judge whether the user is at risk of thermoplegia through the health data collected by the external sensor module and transmits the data to the Android APP through the communication module, and issues a warning if there is a risk. In the physical test, it is found that the heart rate data processed by the original algorithm of the heart rate sensor (MAX30102) fluctuates greatly, based on this improving the original algorithm to reduce the data fluctuation by 44%. According to the results of physical testing, the optimized bracelet system has excellent performance and can meet the actual user requirements.

articleTitle: Ground Calibration of Long-focal-length Linear Array Camera Based on Collimator and Two-Axis Rotary Table
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: This paper proposes a ground calibration method for long-focal-length linear array cameras based on collimator and a two-axis rotary table. By integrating a slit target with the collimator, we construct a target plane at infinity. A multi-scale image extraction method is employed to accurately determine the center of the integrated image in the linear array camera. Building upon the imaging model of the linear array camera and using angular distance as a constraint, we derive the internal camera parameters through nonlinear optimization. Experiments validate the feasibility and effectiveness of the ground calibration method for long-focal-length linear array optical cameras. This technique is particularly suitable for ground calibration in laboratory settings, offering high accuracy, speed, and cost-effectiveness calibration. It plays a pivotal role in ensuring high-resolution imaging and precision positioning in domains like aerospace and remote sensing surveying and mapping.

articleTitle: Research on personnel management and monitoring system based on real-time image enhancement algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: Recently, the demand for fast and real-time personnel management and monitoring system in various companies has increased year by year. It is economical to realize this function with efficient computer vision algorithm compared with using more advanced hardware. Notably, the convolutional neural networks (CNN) have yield incredible performance in the filed of image super-resolution. Nevertheless, most of the previous high-performance SR models needs lots of computational resources and fail to satisfy the real-time requirements of monitoring system. Thus, we propose a lightweight multilevel channel attention network (LMCAN) based on lightweight multilevel feature extraction and fusion (LMFEF) architecture. Besides, the LMFEF is constructed based on the designed lightweight channel attention block (LCAB), which can effectively refabricate the extracted high-frequency information. Adequate experimental results demonstrate that LMCAN is superior than other compared methods quantitatively and qualitatively.

articleTitle: Method for Safety Helmet Detection Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: The importance of wearing safety helmets in construction production cannot be overstated, as it is crucial for effective safety management. Addressing the challenges posed by the large number of parameters and computations in detection models, as well as issues such as false detection and omission in complex environments, this paper presents a lightweight safety helmet detection method based on an improved YOLOv5s.Initially, data augmentation techniques are employed to expand the original dataset, thereby enhancing the model's robustness in intricate construction environments. Subsequently, lightweight Ghost modules are incorporated in place of certain convolutional modules within the original YOLOv5s network, resulting in a reduction of the model's parameter quantity and GFLOPs. Furthermore, the SimAM attention mechanism is introduced to bolster the network's feature extraction capability and strengthen feature representation ability. Finally, the SIoU loss function is uti-lized to expedite convergence speed and elevate model accuracy.Experimental results demonstrate that, in comparison to the original YOLOv5s algorithm, the mAP of the GSS-YOLOv5 algorithm attains 94.1%, while the parameter quantity and GFLOPs are diminished by 20% and 16.5%, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Early Warning Algorithms for Marine Life at Nuclear Power Plant Water Intake
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: This study investigates an early warning algorithm for the drift paths and diffusion outcomes of marine organisms based on data processing and analysis. The algorithm collects data from sonar images at the nuclear power plant’s water intake, above-water camera images, water quality data, sea surface wind observation data, and satellite radiation observation data for analysis and modeling. Using a marine organism database, it estimates the drift paths and diffusion outcomes, presenting the forecast results through visualisation techniques. The purpose of this early warning algorithm research is to enhance the accuracy and timeliness of marine organism monitoring and warnings at the water intake. It prepares preventive measures for potential marine organism outbreaks and spreads, making a significant contribution to ensuring the safety of the cooling source in nuclear power plants.

articleTitle: Research on the Turnout Monitoring System Based on Acceleration Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: This article designs a turnout monitoring system based on acceleration sensors, which can monitor the key infrastructure of rail transit - turnout devices in real-time online. It can automatically measure important parameters such as opening range and lock amount of the turnout. When these parameters exceed the normal range, the system will cut off the representation circuit of the turnout in the interlocking system through a safety relay to achieve the purpose of remote monitoring of the turnout. The system’s sound and light alarm function enables on-site operators to quickly locate the position of turnouts, which improve the efficiency of maintenance operations. This article firstly establishes a mathematical model for measuring turnout parameters such as opening range, stroke, and lock amount based on acceleration sensor data. Secondly, the hardware and software of the monitoring system was designed by using information technology such as embedded systems. Finally, the reliability and accuracy of the measurement mathematical model in this paper were verified through onsite experiments.

articleTitle: Early Diagnosis of Parkinson’s Disease via Speech Signal Recognition: A Time-Frequency Adaptive Multi-Scale Sensing Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: The spotlight has increasingly shifted towards AI-assisted medical diagnosis in recent years. As a prevalent ailment among the elderly, Parkinson’s disease (PD) necessitates automated AI algorithms for enhanced diagnostic efficiency in early detection and recognition. Speech, one of the fundamental biological attributes of humans, can manifest initial indications of Parkinson’s disease. Considering its simplicity, non-invasiveness, cost-effectiveness, and diagnostic convenience, speech signal analysis holds significant promise as a tool for early Parkinson’s disease detection. This study introduces a time-frequency adaptive multi-scale sensing network (TF-AMSP) designed for speech analysis, which can not only capture the intricate time-frequency features embedded within speech signals, but also adeptly process critical information across varying time scales. When compared to the latest methodologies, our model exhibits competitive performance, attaining an accuracy of 98.33%.

articleTitle: Study on Improving Ship Punctuality to Port Based on Response Surface Methodology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: The punctuality rate of vessels arriving at ports is a pivotal operational indicator in the maritime industry, exerting a direct influence on cargo efficiency and economic benefits. Therefore, the exploration of effective approaches to enhance ship punctuality to ports holds significant practical implications and economic value for the maritime industry. In this study, the response surface methodology is employed to establish a predictive model for ship punctuality to ports. Firstly, a substantial amount of simulated shipping data was collected and subjected to exploratory data analysis to identify the primary factors influencing ship punctuality to ports. Subsequently, leveraging the modeling technique based on response surface methodology, a relationship model between ship punctuality to ports and different factor conditions was established. By subjecting the response surface equation to response surface analysis and residual analysis, the accuracy and reliability of the predictive model were validated. Concurrently, a comprehensive analysis of the significance of various influencing factors on different levels of ship punctuality to ports was conducted. Finally, through residual analysis and validation of predictive outcomes, the enhancement of ship punctuality to ports was evaluated.

articleTitle: Fused Lasso Additive Quantile Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: Additive quantile regression provides a flexible and robust approach for modeling nonlinear relationships. The usual method of fitting an additive quantile model is to approximate the components with a spline function, this method requires an a priori selection of knots and is computationally slow which makes it unsuitable for training large-scale data problems. We propose an adaptive additive quantile estimator by using the fused Lasso penalty. Utilizing the sparsity of the discrete first derivative matrix in the fused Lasso penalty enables fast computation of the model, adaptive selection of knots and prediction of desired quartiles or even extreme quartiles. Furthermore, we develop an algorithm that guarantees convergence to the global optimum. The experimental results show that the proposed model has significant advantages over other models.

articleTitle: Feature Re-enhanced Meta-Contrastive Learning for Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: Enhancing the performance of recommendation systems through joint modeling of user-item interactions and knowledge graph (KG) information using Graph Neural Networks (GNN) has shown promising results. However, due to the cold-start problem and inherent sparsity in graph data, the effectiveness of extracting informative features from the graph data is often limited. Existing approaches mostly focus on enhancing the original embeddings. It is imperative to develop a comprehensive and effective multi-faceted feature enhancement strategy that assists in augmenting information during the feature transfer process. In this paper, we present a novel framework for recommendation called Feature Re-enhanced Meta Contrastive Learning (FReML). The framework employs a simple self-gating mechanism to handle the features in the interaction view, enhancing the correlation between user and item features. It utilizes a multi-layer perceptron approach for meta-feature extraction on both the interaction view and the knowledge graph view, aiming to enhance the performance of contrastive learning. We assess the performance of our framework on real-world datasets and showcase superior training results in comparison to state-of-the-art approaches. Additional ablation analysis provides further evidence supporting the rationale and effectiveness of the key component designs.

articleTitle: Multi-Model Parkinson’s Speech Classification Model (MM-Parkinson)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a common neurodegenerative disorder that affects a significant number of individuals globally. The early and precise diagnosis of PD is imperative for timely implementation of treatment strategies. In this regard, a novel approach is proposed in this paper that combines Contrastive Learning of Representations For Improved Environmental Sound Classification and GLobal-Aware Multi-scale to improve the classification of PD from speech recordings. SoundCLR is a recently introduced self-supervised learning method that leverages consistency predictions to learn robust representations. GLAM, on the other hand, captures essential information in speech emotion through multi-scale feature representation and global perception fusion, and then employs data enhancement methods to train and optimize the model. By integrating these two techniques, we endeavor to achieve enhanced performance in PD classification, providing a valuable tool for medical professionals to diagnose and manage the disease more effectively. This approach offers a promising solution for accurately checking PD at an early phase, thus facilitating timely treatment for patients.

articleTitle: Research on stock recommendation system based on improved collaborative filtering
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: This paper proposes a stock recommendation model based on improved collaborative filtering by integrating investor-stock interaction data into the similarity calculation process of traditional collaborative filtering recommendation systems. Experimental comparisons were made with recommendation algorithms based on association rules, text content, and traditional collaborative filtering. The results show that the improved collaborative filtering stock recommendation method has higher accuracy, recall rate, and Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) at different recommendation lengths, thereby verifying the effectiveness of the proposed stock recommendation model.

articleTitle: Transmission Rate Fairness Guarantee in Mutualistic Symbiotic Radio Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: This paper proposes a resource allocation scheme based on the max-min transmission rate to ensure the fairness of multiple secondary users (SUs) in the mutualistic symbiotic network, where SUs can harvest energy from primary user’s (PU’s) signal and transmit information by modulating their signal onto the PU’s signal (also known as backscattering communication). Under the constraints of SUs’ energy causality and quality of service, a resource optimization problem with max-min SU’s transmission rate is constructed by jointly optimizing the PU’s transmit power, the SUs’ backscatter coefficients, and the time to carry out backscatter transmission with a nonlinear energy harvesting model. Due to the max-min function and the coupling of multiple variables, the original problem is non-convex and hard to solve directly. We first transform it into a convex one by introducing slack variable, the proof by contradiction and the introduction of auxiliary variables, and then solve it by the convex optimization tool CVX. Simulation results demonstrated that the proposed resource allocation scheme can effectively improve the fairness of SUs’ transmission rate and verified that SUs can still bring performance gain to the PU in this scheme.

articleTitle: Research on Infrared Detection Capability of Ships Based on Orthogonal Test
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: The development of modern marine technology promotes frequent marine activities and marine traffic, and at the same time brings maritime security issues that cannot be ignored. Traditional optical and radio detection technologies are usually affected by many factors, and the detection effect is poor in bad weather and nighttime environments. In order to improve maritime safety requirements, infrared camera detection is regarded as an effective supplementary means. Considering that the current infrared detection capability is relatively weak, an orthogonal experimental design method is proposed. Through simulation, it is obtained that the detection distance is 120km of A at level 1, the spatial angle is 30-60° of B at level 2, the camera angle of view is the elevation angle of C at level 1, and the scanning period is D at level 3. The combination of 5s is the combination with the best recognition efficiency among the combinations of each factor level, that is, A<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>D<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>. First, briefly introduce the working principle of offshore infrared camera detection and the steps of orthogonal test design, then determine the level of factors that affect the detection ability, and design a factor level table. On this basis, the orthogonal test design was carried out, and 27 sets of test results were obtained. Finally, through the analysis and verification of the test results, the primary and secondary order of the factors affecting the detection ability were obtained, and then the optimal detection scheme was obtained.

articleTitle: AR-based Remote Maintenance System Design for Buses
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: The Bus is an essential way of transportation in China, and the operation and maintenance of the bus is an important task to ensure regular operation. To improve the efficiency of bus operation and maintenance as well as reduce the maintenance cost. In this paper, we utilize Augmented Reality (AR) technology to design an AR-based remote operation and maintenance system for buses. Firstly, we introduce the main objectives of the system and the overall framework and give the maintenance guideline library and the client function design scheme of the system. Finally, AR technology provides accurate virtual guidance in the maintenance process of remote maintenance and remote monitoring. The experimental results show that this system can improve efficiency, reduce maintenance costs, and provide better user experience and service. At the same time, the system can also provide a full range of training and learning resources for maintenance personnel to improve their technical level and maintenance ability.

articleTitle: A Noval Image Encryption Algorithm Based on DNA sequence operation and Chaotic System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: The digital image stores the important information, so it’s extremely important to protect the security of image information transmission. This paper proposes a noval digital image encryption algorithm based on insert-delete model and 2D Logistic chaotic system. In the first step, the original image is divided into four sub-images by quaternary coding, and each sub-image is coded separately. This can improve the security of the encryption algorithm, because the attacker can only recover useful information if he obtains all the sub-images. In addition, 2D logical chaotic system is used in the encryption scheme, which has a large key space. Experimental data and simulation results show that the scheme has high security, can resist exhaustive attacks, statistical attacks and differential cryptanalysis, and has good encryption effect.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Electromagnetic Interference in Secondary Equipment of the Substations
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: With the progress of the society, the demand of the power system is increasing. Accordingly, the power system becomes more complex. Thus, the secondary equipment in the substation is easy to be interfered by the electromagnetic fields. Thus, the evaluation of electromagnetic interference in the secondary equipment of the substation become challenge and is in urgent need. In order to address this problem, a new approach is proposed. Specifically, many affected factors are included for the evaluation. These included factors are processed by the analytic hierarchy process scheme. Experimental results have shown the usefulness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Craniofacial Similarity Evaluation Based on SPCT Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: Craniofacial similarity evaluation plays a fundamental role in craniofacial reconstruction, face recognition, and many other fields. Most of the current work on similarity evaluation is based on traditional 2D images. However, 2D RGB images lack stereoscopic features, and the feature information of depth images is also incomplete. Therefore, evaluating the similarity directly based on the 3D point cloud data with more feature information is more accurate. In this paper, we use point clouds as input to build a new 3D deep learning network, SPCT (Siamese Point Cloud Transformer). More specifically, the Point Cloud Transformer network (PCT) is taken as a branch network to perform feature extraction on the input point cloud data, and a Siamese network with a dual-branch structure is used to implement the similarity calculation function. In morphing experiments, our network showed higher accuracy in both face and skull datasets. Subjective and objective experimental results prove that our method can effectively evaluate the similarity of 3D craniofacial data.

articleTitle: Research on the electric vehicles routing problem considering driving style
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: Electric vehicles are expected to replace fuel vehicles, but there is still a large gap compared with fuel vehicles. In the current situation where the vehicle battery energy is limited, we established the energy consumption model of electric vehicles by introducing the decision variable of driving style. According to the conditions such as the limited power of electric vehicles to establish relevant restrictions, the effects of different driving styles on the optimization of electric vehicles are estimated, then design electric vehicle path planning schemes. The experimental results show that by improving the driving style of the driver, it can reduce the cost of delivery, which has certain practical significance for logistics distribution activities.

articleTitle: Graph Convolution Based Wireless Network Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: Wireless network fault detection achieves through the analysis of temporal correlation data, which has the advantage of quick abnormal identity. However, there exists limitations in some certain scenarios. The target node is probably misjudged as faulty while data fluctuations of its neighboring nodes incur the data flow of the target node. To address this issue, a new network fault detection is proposed based on Graph Convolutional Networks. Our model is built by considering temporal correlation, as well as spatial correlations among wireless network sensors. The graph convolution is operated to capture the spatial-temporal dependencies among nodes for wireless network fault diagnosis. It demonstrated by experiments that our model has higher accuracy in comparison with other competitors. It also can effectively distinguish multiple root cause even when they exist simultaneously.

articleTitle: Pre-design Evaluation System for Urban Design Based on the RDF
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: Urban design methodology relies on synthesizing knowledge and information from multiple domains and platforms. The integration, storage, and retrieval of this extensive multi-source data must be conducted rationally. However, City Information Models (CIM) and Urban Digital Twins (UDT) primarily prioritize geometric information, neglecting the integration and management of semantic and dynamic information. This limitation hinders comprehensive analysis and simulation, and fails to provide detailed references for policymakers and designers. Drawing upon a comprehensive literature review, this study proposes a structured data integration system for urban and districts based on the Resource Description Framework (RDF). This system encompasses geometric, semantic, and dynamic information. Objects are defined as instances with accompanying semantic information, forming a network of topological relationships. Furthermore, raw dynamic information, such as passenger and traffic flows, is characterized, simplified, and stored as data segments for simulation. This system serves as the foundational data source for developing smart city platforms. It finds application in the pre-evaluation of planning and design projects, promoting sustainable energy usage, enhancing public health, and more. Consequently, it contributes significantly to the advancement of digital cities.

articleTitle: A Coordinate Enhanced Local and Global Attention Network for Handwriting Detection of Parkinson’s Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: In recent times, there has been a growing utilization of artificial intelligence in aiding medical diagnoses, with increasing adoption of this advanced technology to improve the patient experience and increase the efficiency of healthcare processes. Increased global aging has focused more research on early recognition and evaluation of Parkinson's disease (PD). Hand movement disorders are a major motor disorder frequently employed in the clinical assessment of PD, resulting in abnormal writing performance in the majority of individuals with Parkinson's disease. Evaluating and recognizing the quality of hand movements is pivotal in the early diagnosis of PD. In this research, we design a coordinate enhanced local and global attention network (CoorLGNet) for handwriting recognition in PD patients and healthy individuals. Based on CNN and Transformer, the proposed network extracts multi-scale features of handwriting through a hierarchical structure, which can assess its potential in identifying PD. The presented model undergoes training and assessment using two openly accessible handwriting datasets. Compared to several cutting-edge approaches, our model obtains competitive classification results with accuracies of 94.94% and 93.58%, respectively.

articleTitle: Medical Surgical Robot Models Design Based on Emotional Imagery
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: With emotion-centric design as the foundation, this study investigates the design of medical surgical robot models that better align with users' emotional needs. This paper comprehensively applies the three-tier theory of emotion-centric design and principal component analysis to analyze the emotional image impact factors of existing medical surgical robot product designs. It identifies the emotional factors affecting users and their corresponding design elements for the appearance of medical surgical robot products. Ultimately, this study identifies the key design elements in medical surgical robot products that influence user emotional preferences, develops design proposals, and conducts evaluations, providing a reference direction for future medical surgical robot design.

articleTitle: Research on Data Security Protection in Power System Automation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: Electric power is an important basic industry in social development and the production and living structure of the people, and plays an important role in the national economy and people’s livelihood. As the cornerstone of national operation, the power system bears the basic mission of supporting national economic and social development. How to effectively protect the power system automation data and realize the stable operation of the system has become a huge challenge for the development of power enterprises. In order to solve this dilemma, based on the research of power system structure, data type and the development status of security protection, combined with computer electronic technology, this paper carried out in-depth research on data security protection in power system automation, and built a security protection model based on its theoretical basis. In order to verify the effectiveness of the model, this paper tested it from three dimensions: data security protection degree, risk processing efficiency and response time, and compared it with the traditional security protection model. The test results showed that under different test cases, the maximum protection degree of the data security protection model in this paper has reached 95.16%, and its average protection degree was about 91.88%. From the specific test results, it can be seen that the application of data security protection in power system automation based on computer electronic technology has strong operability.

articleTitle: Research On Altofrequency Ultrasound Image Assisted Diagnosis of Liver Cirrhosis Based On Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: We consider the problem of feature extraction in ultrasound diagnosis of cirrhosis. The classification of liver cirrhosis is mainly based on the performance of ultrasonic images of liver capsule and liver parenchyma. The traditional way is to extract the features manually and classify them with appropriate classifiers. One possible consequence of this approach is that the experimental results are over-dependent on feature extraction, and the artificial uncertainty leads to the reduced generalization ability of the model. To solve this problem, we propose a novel neural network based on deep learning to complete the task of detection and classification. Compared with the low-level features extracted manually, the high-dimensional features extracted by the neural network can effectively improve the diagnostic accuracy. Experiments show that the proposed method has more advantages in diagnostic accuracy. The three-stage classification of cirrhosis was well completed. Finally, from the perspective of engineering application, a set of auxiliary diagnosis system for cirrhosis is designed and implemented based on the proposed network algorithm to assist clinicians in diagnosis.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Deep Information Mining for Fusion Motor Symptom Evaluation in Detection of Parkinson's Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: In recent years, the detection and recognition of Parkinson's disease have received widespread attention from researchers in the field of artificial intelligence. At present, fruitful results have been achieved by using intelligent methods to detect individual motor symptoms of Parkinson's disease. However, a common challenge in these studies is the limited availability of data due to privacy concerns, making it difficult to obtain diverse symptom data for evaluation purposes. We thus propose the Multimodal Fusion Recognition Model for Parkinson's Disease. This model tackles the problem of cross-modal data fusion and comprises two main components: a multimodal fusion model and a recognition model. First, we extract gait information containing temporal and force-sensing features, as well as handwritten image information that captures spatial strokes. The feature fusion process aligns the different types of data to make them complementary for recognition. Afterwards, we feed the enriched features into our proposed Multi-scale Variable Dimensional Dynamic Convolutional Network with Interlayer Deep Attention. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our multimodal fusion method outperforms existing unimodal recognition methods. Furthermore, the recognition model surpasses several methods and achieves new SOTA results on fusion data.

articleTitle: Improved YOLOv5 based on CBAM and BiFPN for Rice Pest and Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Internet of Things and Smart City (CIoTSC)
abstract: Addressing the issue where traditional YOLOv5 algorithm struggles in accurately detecting pests and diseases of small to medium scale with dense leaf distribution in rice, this study introduces an enhanced YOLOv5-CW algorithm model, derived from the original YOLOv5, specifically for rice pest and disease detection. Firstly, the feature fusion is improved by introducing the improved three-layer BiFPN (Bidirectional Feature Pyramid Network) weighted bidirectional feature pyramid network BiFPN-W into the original YOLOv5 algorithm to replace the original Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) structure and Path Aggregation Network (PAN) structure in the Neck part, which can fuse more features without increasing the cost. Second, the introduction of Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) attention mechanism will significantly improve the detection of small targets for the identification of small-scale pests and dis-eases in rice plants. Finally, experiments are conducted on the dataset. The experimental results showed that compared with the detection of rice pests using the traditional YOLOv5 algorithm, the precision (P) and recall (R) rates of the improved YOLOv5-CW algorithm model detection increased from 86.05% and 77.46% to 90.65% and 85.63%, respectively, and the mean Average Precision (mAP) also increased from 83.52% to 87.40%, while the detection speed reached 22.38ms, which is faster than the detection speed of the original YOLOv5 algorithm. Meanwhile, compared with target detection algorithms such as SSD, Faster R-CNN, and YOLOv4, this improved algorithm has certain superiority and is an ideal model in rice pests and diseases.
